engine.name: tempo2-rust
engine.numeric_backend: Rug 1.30.0 / MPFR; native reference long double and TKsign_d/TKretMax_d are binary64
engine.arithmetic_rounding: nearest ties to even; nonfused source operations; T2_SVD_TOL binary64 1e-27
engine.support_profile: M2 isolated TCB @ / PKS, ZERO and local F0-F3
engine.source_correspondence: TEMPO2 fda6ad4a9753ad7dc5d291406f2f310a9161423f; A2 7795d53eeca32ef3dbb61c2b6cdb1c3e7c5d3572; t2fit.C / TKfit.C / TKsvd.C / t2fit_stdFitFuncs.C / tempo2.C

par.text:
PSRJ J0000-0000
RAJ 01:00:00.00000
DECJ -00:00:00.00000
F0 10.12345678902 1 1e-40
F1 -9.998e-16 1 1e-40
F2 5e-26 1 1e-40
F3 3.7e-33 1 1e-40
PEPOCH 54000
POSEPOCH 54000
DMEPOCH 54000
DM 100
EPHVER 5
CLK TT(TAI)
EPHEM DE405
UNITS TCB
MODE 0
NITS 2

conventions.phase_reference: signed fractional reduced phase of first input TOA
conventions.corrections: PKS: TT(TAI), IF99, DE405, IAU2000B, frequency dilation, Sun/planet Shapiro, DM, IPM=1 NE_SW=4 SWM=0, troposphere with TEMPO2 meteorology fallback

covariance_coordinates: raw unscaled source fit coordinates (not physical spin covariance)
